prompt:

Use a consistent three-quarter product presentation angle with the front lens clearly visible, upper-left lighting and crisp dark lower-right shading.

Authentic detailed 16-bit Game Boy Advance pixel art matching the existing spacecraft equipment icons and Mars Crafts rover.

Centered complete item inside a transparent 32x32 canvas, no text, no background, no frame, no rover.
